ai.warmup.prompt: Start this new conversation with a short introduction as my reading assistant. first_run.ai_ollama_hint: Don’t have Ollama yet? After these steps, Settings → AI Reader helps you install it and pick a suitable model.
first_run.ai_text: The AI Reader is an optional second pair of eyes on your own text: for feedback, persona and style checks, facts, continuity and consistency. It does not write for you and is off by default. Ollama stays local. With OpenRouter, text and context you deliberately send may leave your computer.
first_run.language_text: Choose the application language and colour scheme. You can change everything later in Settings.
first_run.spelling_none: There is no dictionary on this computer yet. Download one below, or do it later in Settings → Spelling.
first_run.spelling_text_171: QuietWriter checks your spelling with a dictionary. Choose one that is already on this computer, for example from ONLYOFFICE or LibreOffice, or download one.
first_run.theme_preview_text: This preview changes immediately. Choose what feels comfortable to read; you can always change it later.
first_run.title: Welcome to QuietWriter
first_run.tour_books_text: Your books live on the Bookshelf. Open a book to write and organise chapters. QuietWriter saves automatically while you write; Version History helps you recover earlier versions.
first_run.tour_enable: Show me briefly where everything is
first_run.tour_finish_text: The optional AI Reader gives feedback on your text, but does not write it for you. Export creates formats including EPUB, PDF and Markdown. Integrity & recovery and Trash help when you need to inspect or restore something.
first_run.tour_finish_tip: You do not have to remember all of this. QuietWriter keeps the interface calm and you can always change settings later.
first_run.tour_optional: The tour is explanation only. You can skip it; every feature remains available.
first_run.tour_planning_text: Planning keeps scenes, characters and notes together. In Darlings: Don't kill your darlings. Keep beautiful pieces that no longer fit, find them later and reuse them elsewhere.
first_run.tour_text: New writers should not have to figure QuietWriter out by themselves. The next screens briefly explain where to find your books, writing, planning, Darlings, AI Reader, history and export.
first_run.update_privacy: Automatic checking is only a short version check. QuietWriter never downloads or installs anything without your action.
first_run.update_text: QuietWriter can ask GitHub whether a newer stable version is available. No books, manuscripts or other content are sent. You can always check manually in Settings.
first_run.workspace_text: QuietWriter stores your books, planning and local recovery data here. Production and development can use separate workspaces.
first_run.workspace_unsafe: Books and backups must not be stored inside the program folder. Choose a workspace outside the QuietWriter installation.

panel_help.ai: Ask a question about your text, or select a passage and pick a quick action. The answer appears here; your manuscript only changes when you edit it yourself. Under Context you can see what is sent.
panel_help.chapter_context: Here you see the scenes and characters you linked to this chapter in Planning, so your plan is at hand while you write. To change them, go to Planning.
panel_help.chapter_context_170: Here you see the scenes from Planning for this chapter, in the same order as the scene breaks in your text: scene 1 is the part before the first break, scene 2 the part after it. You also see which characters appear in the text. You make changes in Planning; your text is never touched.
panel_help.darlings: Keep text you cut but don't want to lose here. Select a passage and copy or cut it to Darlings. Everything you keep can be found again via Open Darlings.
panel_help.history: Every day you write, QuietWriter automatically keeps a version of your book. Create a version yourself before a big change, and star the versions that matter. Old daily versions are thinned out; starred versions are always kept (Settings > Backups).
panel_help.open_points: Mark words or passages you want to fill in later, instead of typing XXX or TODO. QuietWriter keeps track of them here and warns you before an export. The marker itself never ends up in your export.
panel_help.search: Search this chapter, this section or the whole book. Replace matches one at a time, or all at once with Replace all.
panel_help.spell: Go through the unknown words in this chapter one by one. Ignore skips only this spot; Ignore all lasts until you close QuietWriter. Always ignore and Add to dictionary remember the word for good.

persona.info: Your writer persona helps the Reader get to know you as a writer. Use it to describe what is characteristic of your voice, tone, rhythm, word choice and editorial preferences. This lets the Reader point out when a passage does or does not fit your own style without writing that style for you. The persona applies to all books; a Book profile can define deliberate exceptions for one specific book. This context is sent with each Reader request to the selected AI provider; with an external provider, this data leaves your computer.

settings.ai.auth_method_help: Choose how QuietWriter connects to OpenRouter. Only the selected method is used.
settings.ai.disable_thinking_help: Asks the selected provider to disable reasoning/thinking when the model supports it. Leave this off to use the model default.
settings.ai.enable_help: Shows the Reader and its context features in QuietWriter. When disabled, Reader, Writer persona, Book profile and Book memory disappear from the interface. All content and settings remain stored and return when the AI Reader is enabled again.
settings.ai.free_router_hint: OpenRouter Free selects a free model for each message. Writing style and capabilities may vary. Choose a specific model for more consistency.
settings.ai.intro: The AI Reader is a second pair of eyes on your manuscript. It helps with feedback, persona and style checks, facts, continuity and consistency, but it does not take over the writing. It does not write or rewrite manuscript text and never edits your manuscript autonomously. QuietWriter does not include an AI model itself: connect a local model through Ollama or an external model through OpenRouter.
settings.ai.model_help:
QuietWriter sends only the context selected in the Reader sidebar together with your writer persona.
🆓 = free via OpenRouter according to the most recently fetched pricing information.
🧠 = the provider reports that this model supports thinking/reasoning. QuietWriter can request thinking to be disabled when the provider allows it; some model variants may ignore that request. Without thinking, responses are often faster and more direct. The effect varies by model.
settings.ai.ollama_setup_help: QuietWriter checks whether Ollama is running on this computer and can download a suitable model for you.
settings.ai.ollama_url_help: Only relevant when Ollama is selected as provider.
settings.ai.openrouter_browser_help: Sign in through your browser. QuietWriter saves the connection in Windows Credential Manager.
settings.ai.openrouter_free_only_help: Shows only OpenRouter models whose current prompt and output prices are zero. Use Fetch models to refresh the price status.
settings.ai.openrouter_free_tip: Free via OpenRouter according to the most recently fetched pricing information.
settings.ai.openrouter_key_help: Use your own API key. It is stored locally in your QuietWriter settings.
settings.ai.openrouter_login_success: Connected. The key is stored securely. Select a model and save your settings.
settings.ai.openrouter_removed: The local browser connection has been removed. You can also revoke the key at openrouter.ai/settings/keys.
settings.ai.openrouter_wait: Waiting for browser authorization (up to three minutes)…
settings.ai.provider_help: Ollama runs locally on your computer. OpenRouter uses an external API key.
settings.ai.quick_actions_expanded_help: Shows the three Reader quick actions immediately when the panel opens. When off, they remain available through the Quick actions button without permanently using space.
settings.ai.thinking_fixed_tip: This model supports thinking, but the provider reports no disabled mode for this variant.
settings.ai.thinking_model_tip: This model supports thinking and explicitly reports that thinking can be disabled.
settings.ai.thinking_unknown_tip: This model supports thinking. QuietWriter can request thinking to be disabled, but the provider does not report whether this model variant is guaranteed to support that control.
settings.ai.writing_models_help: Hides clearly specialized programming models. General-purpose models remain visible.
settings.appearance.font_help: Recommended fonts are loaded by QuietWriter itself. All available system fonts remain available below them.
settings.appearance.font_sample: The first sentence of a new story often begins with a single idea.
settings.appearance.indent_help: Following paragraphs are indented. The first paragraph of a chapter, after a blank line, subheading or scene break starts flush left.
settings.appearance.intro: Adjust the theme and writing typography. Previews are applied immediately; Save makes the choice persistent.
settings.appearance.line_spacing_help: Controls the vertical space between lines in the writing editor.
settings.appearance.paragraph_spacing_he: Adds subtle extra space between consecutive paragraphs.
settings.appearance.planning_ghosts_help: Shows scenes linked from Planning as soft guidance in an empty chapter. This text never becomes part of the manuscript, is not counted and is not exported.
settings.appearance.scale_help: Makes all buttons, menus and text larger or smaller, on top of the Windows scaling. Applied after restarting QuietWriter.
settings.appearance.smart_quotes_help: Turns straight quotes, apostrophes, -- and ... into the right typographic characters for the book’s language (for example “ ”, ’, — and …).
settings.appearance.text_width_help: Controls how much white space appears to the left and right of the text. This only changes the view and does not affect your manuscript or export.
settings.appearance.theme_help: Applies the complete interface theme immediately as a preview.
settings.backup.book_missing: This book is no longer available.
settings.backup.busy: Wait until the current backup finishes.
settings.backup.busy_automatic: QuietWriter is already backing up a book. Please try again afterward.
settings.backup.choose_path: Choose a folder outside your workspace
settings.backup.close_book: Close this book before restoring it.
settings.backup.close_busy: A backup is still being made. Close QuietWriter once it has finished.

settings.backup.complete_simple: The backup was saved in your backup folder.
settings.backup.confirm_body: You are about to replace “{title}” with the backup from {date}. Later changes will no longer be in the active book. QuietWriter will first preserve a safety copy of your current book.
settings.backup.done_body: “{title}” has been restored. The previous version is safely kept in your backup folder.
settings.backup.enable_help: Optional: one backup per changed book every 24 hours, while QuietWriter is open.
settings.backup.failed: An automatic backup failed. Check your backup folder.
settings.backup.hidden_book: This book is unavailable in Presentation Mode.
settings.backup.intro: Keep an extra copy of your books outside your workspace. QuietWriter makes a separate folder for each book. You can also restore an earlier copy here; an existing book is never replaced without asking.
settings.backup.location_help: Keep backups somewhere other than your books. You can restore via Import book.
settings.backup.manual_help: Choose a book and make a safe copy right away. You can keep writing while it copies.
settings.backup.missing: First choose a book and a backup folder.
settings.backup.need_folder: Choose a backup folder for the safety copy first.
settings.backup.replace_intro: “{title}” is already in your Bookshelf. Replace the existing book with this backup?
settings.backup.restore_help: Choose a backup by date or select a file yourself. An existing book is never silently replaced.
settings.backup.save_first: The book could not be saved. The backup has not started.
settings.backup.select_book: Select a book to see its latest backup.
settings.backup.wrong_book: This backup belongs to another book.
settings.general.advanced_options_help: Shows specialist features you do not need for everyday writing. For now this controls Integrity & recovery.
settings.general.autosave_always: QuietWriter saves changes automatically. Ctrl+S remains available to save immediately.
settings.general.autosave_help: Automatically saves changes about three seconds after your last keystroke. When disabled, use Ctrl+S to save manually.
settings.general.guided_export_help: Export starts with a few short questions: what do you want to do with your book? Off: you see all export settings straight away. You can also switch on the Export page itself.
settings.general.language_help: The selected language is applied after restarting QuietWriter.
settings.help.help: Shows the short explanations in the right-hand panels again, as on first use. Your books and settings stay as they are.
settings.help.label: Panel explanations
settings.help.reset_done: Explanations are shown again in all panels.
settings.help.shortcuts_help: An overview of all shortcuts. You can also open it any time with Ctrl+/ or F1.
settings.history.thin_help: QuietWriter keeps a version of your book for every day you write. Daily versions older than 30 days are reduced to one per week, and older than six months to one per month. Starred versions, versions you create yourself and safety versions are always kept.
settings.progress.enable_help: Opt-in: QuietWriter counts only positive growth that you save yourself in the editor. The daily count stays local to this computer and is not synced. Turning it off stops tracking; existing progress is kept for when you enable it again.
settings.reset.confirm_text: QuietWriter will forget your preferences and show the complete setup again at the next launch. A saved OpenRouter API key is also removed. Your current workspace with books and stories stays in place and is not modified.
settings.reset.confirm_title: Restore program settings to their defaults?
settings.reset.error_text: The settings could not be reset reliably. Your workspace was not modified.
settings.reset.help: Restores program settings and shows the complete setup again at the next launch. Your books and stories are not deleted.
settings.reset.label: Set up QuietWriter again
settings.reset.ready_text: QuietWriter will now quit. The setup starts again on the next launch. Your stories stay in the same workspace.
settings.reset.title: Set up QuietWriter again
settings.reset.workspace_link: Workspace that will be kept: {path}
settings.save_error: The settings could not be written reliably to disk. Check access permissions and try again.
settings.saved_restart_scale: Saved · interface size applies after restart
settings.spelling.check_help: Underlines unknown words in the editor. Your manuscript text is never changed automatically.
settings.spelling.dictionary_choice_help: A dictionary you downloaded or added in QuietWriter, or one that already comes with ONLYOFFICE, LibreOffice or OpenOffice on this computer.
settings.spelling.intro_170: Choose the dictionary and language QuietWriter uses to check spelling.
settings.spelling.manage_help_170b: Download fetches a dictionary from a fixed, verified list. With Add you choose a .dic file yourself. Remove only applies to dictionaries in QuietWriter; those of office programs stay put.
settings.spelling.no_dictionaries_170: There is no dictionary yet. Choose Download… below to get one.
settings.spelling.remove_failed: The dictionary could not be removed.
settings.spelling.updates_available: A newer version is available for: {names}. Choose Download… to update.
settings.storage.cover_path_help: Used in Markdown metadata. Use {slug}, for example /{slug}.jpg or /images/{slug}.jpg.
settings.storage.intro: Choose where QuietWriter stores books and supporting files.
settings.storage.sync_warning: Note: this workspace appears to be inside {provider}. Synced folders can briefly lock files during synchronisation. QuietWriter handles this where possible, but if saving unexpectedly fails, first close other applications using the same files.
settings.storage.workspace_help: Your books, planning, publication structure and local recovery data are stored here. A change takes effect after restart.
settings.title: Settings
settings.updates.auto_help: After starting, QuietWriter asks GitHub whether a new stable version is available. This needs an internet connection. No books or manuscripts are sent. QuietWriter never updates without your choice.
settings.updates.manual_help: You can always check manually, even when automatic checking is disabled.
settings.updates.mode_help: An extracted portable zip updates itself. A source version or a loose program folder does not; then you download new versions from GitHub.
settings.updates.mode_override: This copy updates itself. Test source: {source}
settings.updates.mode_pilot: Test copy: also sees test versions (pre-releases) that users do not see yet.
settings.updates.version_help: Only official stable releases from GitHub. You decide when to update; your books and settings always stay where they are.
settings.updates.version_info: Current version: {current}. Available stable version: not checked yet.
settings.updates.version_latest: Current version: {current}. This is the latest stable version.
settings.workspace_changed_text: The new workspace will be used after the application is restarted.

writing_goal.intro: Set a word goal and optionally choose a target date. QuietWriter can also keep track of how many words you add in the editor today. This is off by default; turning it off keeps the existing count.
